messages:
sarah-support: FYI customer reporting a big mismatch between their AWS marketplace invoice and our usage dashboard for tenant acme-corp-prod. invoice shows 12,345 units, our dashboard shows 8,900 tokens. can someone triage?

kevin-billing: @sarah-support do we have the marketplace line items (raw csv) and the Redwood usage export for the same billing window? need to compare skus + timestamps.

anna-customer: hi — i attached screenshots in the ticket. AWS billed us ~12k units for Apr 12-13 but your dashboard meter shows ~9k. we only ran a few test jobs. happy to share account ids.

mike-eng: thanks @anna-customer can you confirm the account id and the marketplace entitlement id? also any service account keys used during that window?

anna-customer: acct id 123456789012, entitlement arn arn:aws:marketplace:us-east-1::entitlement/ENT-ACME-001. ran a few calls from our QA harness between 03:00-07:00 UTC on Apr 12.

kevin-billing: uploading the AWS lineitem export now. snippet: ``Date,ProductCode,UsageType,UsageQuantity,Cost
2026-04-12,RedwoodInference,TokenUsage,12345,245.90``

mike-eng: our internal usage export for the tenant for the same range: ``2026-04-12,tenant=acme-corp-prod,token_count,8900``. interestingly the marketplace "UsageQuantity" looks like it might be counting 'units' not tokens — are we mapping units -> tokens incorrectly in the marketplace adapter?

jess-prodops: @mike-eng can you grep the marketplace adapter logs for that entitlement arn and timeframe? specifically look for any duplicate meter submissions or retries that could double-count.

mike-eng: running quick grep now. found repeated meter events from the same job id: ``POST /metering/submit 200 job=qa-harness-42 run=1`` then ``POST /metering/submit 200 job=qa-harness-42 run=2`` — looks like the QA harness retried and our adapter accepted both as separate meterings because idempotency_key was missing.

kevin-billing: that would explain an inflated count. marketplace counts every accepted metering record. our dashboard dedupes by request_id but the marketplace only sees raw records.

anna-customer: so the extra ~3,400 units could be retries? can you estimate impact?

mike-eng: rough calc: if one job submission = ~170 tokens, and it retried ~20 times across multiple jobs, that could add ~3-4k units. need to confirm exact counts.

kevin-billing: action items: 1) gather raw marketplace line items (done), 2) gather our metering submission logs for that entitlement (in progress), 3) compute de-duplicated count by correlating request_id/job_id, 4) if marketplace billed duplicates we need to open a dispute with AWS and request credit.

sarah-support: @anna-customer we'll run a reconciliation and follow up within 48h. sorry for the trouble. we'll include a timeline and next steps. :pray:

mike-eng: quick repro steps for our triage notes: 1) run QA harness against RT env with idempotency disabled 2) observe adapter accepting multiple submissions 3) check Redis idempotency store missing key -> adapter posts to marketplace each time 4) confirm marketplace lineitems reflect multiple posts. include log grep: ``grep "metering submit" /var/log/marketplace-adapter.log | grep ENT-ACME-001``

jess-prodops: i also found a deploy on Apr 11 that rolled back idempotency header parsing due to a config change. pushing a fix to re-enable idempotency enforcement now and will patch the adapter to reject duplicates when request_id absent.

kevin-billing: ETA for reconciliation: I'll produce a CSV that maps marketplace UsageQuantity -> our accepted_token_count per job and highlight duplicates. if AWS confirms duplicates were billed, we'll request a credit on their marketplace portal. logging ticket with AWS now.

deploy-bot: [deploy] marketplace-adapter rev 5c7a1d -> 6f2b8a deployed to prod by jess-prodops at 2026-04-13T02:15:30Z

anna-customer: thanks everyone. please include the support ticket # in updates. we've paused sending traffic until you confirm.

sarah-support: support ticket created: #SUP-2026-00458. kevin, mike, jess — keep thread updated. will notify Anna once we have the reconciliation CSV and the AWS dispute number.

kevin-billing: attached reconciliation summary (csv) in ticket: mapping shows marketplace total 12,345 vs our deduped total 8,920; duplicates accounted for 3,425 units. opened AWS dispute case ID: 9876543210, case created 2026-04-13, expected response 5-7 business days.

mike-eng: postmortem notes: root cause = disabled idempotency header parsing during a config rollback. fix = enforce idempotency keys in adapter, emit request_id in metering payload, add integration test that simulates retry and ensures single submission.

sarah-support: closing loop with customer now. Anna, we will apply a credit once AWS confirms the dispute. apologies again. :heart:

anna-customer: appreciate the quick work. please confirm when credit applied and adapter fix deployed.

jess-prodops: patch deployed, integration test added to CI, monitoring alert created for unusual marketplace submission rate for any entitlement (>100/min).

sarah-support: last note: filing internal follow-up ticket to audit other entitlements for similar spikes (SUP-2026-00459).

kevin-billing: marking this thread resolved for now, will update when AWS responds.
